meta.name: migrate-from-v1
meta.description: Finish migrating a NanoClaw v1 install into v2. Run after `bash migrate-v2.sh` completes. Seeds the owner, migrates legacy memory, reconciles container configs, and helps port custom v1 code. Triggers on "migrate from v1", "finish migration", "v1 migration".

copy.tagline: 把旧版安装平滑升级到新版
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在把旧版迁移到新版
copy.tagline_en: Finish upgrading your old install to the new version
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're moving from an old version to a new one

howto.what: 它接着 migrate-v2.sh 完成 v1→v2 迁移的收尾:读 handoff.json 排查失败步骤、给 owner 授权、设定访问策略、迁移旧记忆、校对容器配置、搬运 fork 自定义代码。
howto.when: 当你说 “migrate from v1”、“finish migration” 等词,或在 migrate-v2.sh 跑完后要接着收尾时触发;若 handoff.json 不存在,它会停下让你先跑脚本。

say.text: 帮我完成 v1 到 v2 的迁移收尾
say.note: 先读 handoff.json,再逐阶段推进

say.text: 把 owner 角色授予我
say.note: 确认用户行后写入 owner 角色

say.text: 访问策略改成「仅已知用户」
say.note: 会提示从 v1 消息记录导入已知用户

howto.what_en: After migrate-v2.sh runs, it finishes the v1 to v2 migration: reads handoff.json, triages failed steps, seeds the owner role, sets access policy, runs /migrate-memory, reconciles container.json, and ports fork customizations.
howto.when_en: Triggers on "migrate from v1", "finish migration", "v1 migration", or when you want to wrap up after migrate-v2.sh. If handoff.json is missing, it stops and asks you to run the script first.

say_en.text: Finish the v1 to v2 migration for me
say_en.note: Reads handoff.json first, then works phase by phase
Confirms your user row, then writes the owner role

say_en.text: Switch the access policy to known users only
say_en.note: Offers to import known senders from v1 message history
